rationale: Focused lncRNA CRISPRa screen (1000 sgRNAs: 160 genes x 6 plus 40 non-targeting NT1-NT40) in MCF-7. The paper describes P0, untreated P14a/b and palbociclib T14a/b/c. GEO labels cdk1 'no drug 4 weeks', but cdk1 correlates 0.994 with cdk3 and cdk2/3 vs cdk1 is uncorrelated with the paper's treatment beta (Spearman -0.02), whereas cdk1-3 vs p14a/b reproduces it (0.91); p14a/b are not technical re-reads (overdispersed against each other like the palbociclib replicates). So cdk1-3 = palbociclib (T14a/b/c), p14a/b = untreated; 3 vs 2, 3 residual df. The focused library holds only genes picked as proliferation hits, so library totals shift with selection (85% of non-targeting guides reached p < 0.05 with library totals); totals are therefore taken from the 40 non-targeting guides, as the paper normalized MAGeCK MLE to them. Only 40 control guides, so no control null and no automatic calibration (it needs 50).
